stackDivergence.rationale: Task106 implements the complete logical configmgr Type enum/list/element/UNO mapping/dynamic sequence whitelist and actual LocalizedPropertyNode/LocalizedValueNode contracts over existing Any/UnoType/Node/NodeMap/SAL owners. Numeric unsigned classification retains the original Any.has call and its result via boolean-indexed alternatives; original UNO primitive compatibility makes the false alternatives unreachable for initialized unsigned primitive owners (CALC-091). No invented range check, fake has result, type/provider replacement, counter mutation or coverage suppression. False alternatives are source-reviewed, not executed native behavior proof; raw100 does not prove unreachable alternatives. Nodes retain independent Any copies, stable value pointer, metadata/user-modified updates including self-set, deep child clones and base-copy description omission (CALC-090). Native const/private-copy syntax and ABI/assertions/staticize/refcount/lifetime machinery are outside represented behavior; ordinary JS node refs add no memory library. Original QA is unexecuted integration context only; no new C++ generator/compiled differential/sanitizer.
